lessons: Review found case-03, case-04 and case-06 to be byte-for-byte copies of case-01 and case-02. Draw at least 6 generate cases under eval/visual/, and give each one its own input.png, base.png, candidate.png and position-and-scale criterion. Run a hash check so no two cases share an image.

Generate cases need clearly good placements that plainly meet the stated position and scale. They also need several kinds of break: off position, wrong scale, clipped, duplicated and seams. Never keep cases with identical inputs that carry opposite labels, as case-05 vs case-01 did.

Command cases also need unique candidate images. case-20 reused case-13's candidate.png and only reworded its criterion. Draw each command case as a new image, for example a missing element, an off-position shape or a clipped object.

Label only through `uv run python -m eval.visual_harness label`. If the panel replies unsure or with an invalid rubric ID, redraw that case. Then run `./dev.py visual-baseline` once over the final distinct set and commit eval/visual_report.json. Record redraws in run.md.
